observations: Two gas cylinders are shown: one orange and one white.
Both cylinders have brass valve caps.
The orange cylinder has a black mesh pattern on the lower body.
The white cylinder shows some surface wear and discoloration.
The background shows other red gas cylinders stacked on a wooden pallet.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' is visible on both photos.

claims.evidence: The white cylinder shows significant surface wear and discoloration.
The capacity markings are not visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be expired or past their re-test date.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be empty or contain a different gas.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the shroud showing the current weight.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while under pressure.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the shroud showing the current weight.
Photo of the expiry or manufacture date stamped on the shroud.
Photo of the valve with a soap bubble test to check for leaks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
